lines.2: Yesterday had been a strange date... if you could call it that.
lines.4: I remembered what came next in middle school.
lines.5: Subaru and I had saved Konoe from the delinquents at school.
lines.6: Still feeling like a hero, I went to school the next day.
lines.7: But what waited for me in class was not applause. It was an awkward atmosphere.
